claims.claim_text: Cautley Nasmyth Shaw held a Royal Air Force Special Reserve commission in 1931 and was granted the honorary rank of Flying Officer.

claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact name and the independent official OSS record identifying Cautley Shaw as an RAF squadron leader.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar military assignment. The source does not establish that this was the immediate predecessor to OSS-related work.
claims.match_notes: This is a military assignment, not a civilian employer or proof of continuous RAF service from 1931 to the OSS period.
